title: The haunted house
narration: Penny enters at night through hinged doors and the connected staircase.

title: A furnished world
narration: Five indexed primitive families form furniture and articulated toys.

title: Inspect the three clues
narration: Train 2, clock 5, blocks 7. The code opens the real toy-room doors.

title: Rescue through hierarchy
narration: Penny activates two switches. Jessie rides Bullseye and dismounts onto the high platform.

title: Buzz and the pursuit
narration: The release removes a translucent barrier. The ghost follows Penny to the stairs.

title: Live character takeover
narration: Woody follows your input while the others continue. Zero releases ownership; N enters full manual mode.

title: Directional, point and spot
narration: Moonlight is directional; the lamp adds a point source and soft spotlight.

title: Gouraud shading
narration: Lighting is evaluated at vertices and interpolated across triangles.

title: Phong shading
narration: Interpolated normals are normalised before per-fragment illumination.

title: Texture coordinates
narration: UVs map wood, wallpaper, fabric and lunar craters onto shared geometry.

title: Analytic ray tracing
narration: A BVH accelerates exact primitive hits, shadows, mirror paths and straight transparency.

title: The entrance breaks
narration: Buzz flies and aims. Only a nearest-hit laser impact releases six physical wood fragments.

title: The toys are safe
narration: Every character is physically outside. The cast idles in the garden. Adiba Tahsin / 2107031 / CSE-4102.
